risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Page/copy counter reading unknown, which affects wear estimate
risks.proof: Photo of the counter screen or service menu showing total page count

Photo of the toner/drum unit removed showing wear level
Photo/screenshot of the internal page counter
